name: 補足付きアカウント設定の一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0027 補足付きアカウント設定の一覧.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render only the7-row account settings list from the source region, not the page header/storage/bottomnavigation. Compact native390px wide by408px high:16px sidepadding,7rows56px each plus8px top/bottom. Body labels Meiryo Regular40014px/24px and supporting descriptions Regular40012px/16px, tracking0, as saved native text properties; do not make all labels bold. Each row:18px source-faithful icon,12px gap, left-aligned two-line text stack, small rightchevron. Exact Japanese pairs, in this order: プランに含まれる機能 / 利用できる機能を確認します ; 写真のアップロード / 写真のバックアップ方法を管理します ; オフラインのファイル / 保存済みのファイルはありません ; パスワード / 保存した情報を安全に管理します ; パソコンと接続 / パソコンでも利用できるようにします ; 削除したファイルを復元 / 削除した項目を取り戻します ; 署名の依頼 / 依頼の進み具合を確認します. Restore rightside オフ before row2chevron: it is visible in original and missing in mock. Match ORIGINAL glyph anatomy: sparklepair; camera with tiny upward uploadarrow at upperright; cloud with downarrow; original filled symmetrical twin keyhole/caps PASSWORDS MARK (not a generic key); complete monitor with small square screen center and stand; bin with upward restorearrow; pen with signature squiggle. Source controls fine shapes and strokeweights; mock malformed vectors are not authority. All utility icons slate#526173, maintext#1D1D1D and descriptions mutedgray. Flat white list on purewhite canvas, optional veryfine insetdividers, no outer card, no coloredicon tiles or huge empty rowgaps. No heading, extrafunctions or inventedvalues.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: No arbitrary green or categorycolors. Slate utilityicons and neutral text/chevrons preserve quiet accountsettings. No primaryaction needs a gradient in thiscomponent.
LATEST DIRECT OWNER DENSITY CORRECTION, 2026-10-18: previous candidates were too big and too spacious. This overrides earlier source-spacing and presentation-enlargement instructions. Use compact ordinary UI proportions, content-driven control widths, restrained small radii, tight but readable padding, and little outer presentation whitespace. Preserve exact established Japanese font roles; do not shrink text to manufacture density. Preserve original icon geometry, strokes, states and artwork. Avoid stretching a small standalone utility control across an entire screen. Use the owner-corrected180x28 three-segment control as a density reference only, not a size to force onto unrelated components. Output image pixels are inspection resolution, never intended application CSS size.
reviewNotes: 7項目と補足、写真アップロードのオフ、原本の7アイコンを復元して目視確認。タイトルが指定Regularより太く見えるため文字ウェイトのみ修正。原本は無彩色のためスレートで統一し装飾色なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
